message.content: {"draft":"Transpose kernel uses wrong strides: input row stride must be N, output row stride must be M. Fix x_ptrs to use N and y_ptrs to use M, keeping masks aligned to each tensor's own dimensions.","plan":"Edit the two pointer arithmetic lines in transpose_kernel: change x_ptrs stride from M to N, and y_ptrs stride from N to M. No other changes needed.","base_sha256":"1bdd6c03d80a1c0b56d3612ee229440739cce5ed59aaf0017d147830e666252b","edits":[{"before_lines":["    x_ptrs = x_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * M + offs_n[None, :]"],"after_lines":["    x_ptrs = x_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * N + offs_n[None, :]"]},{"before_lines":["    y_ptrs = y_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * N + offs_m[None, :]"],"after_lines":["    y_ptrs = y_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * M + offs_m[None, :]"]},{"before_lines":["    tl.store(y_ptrs, x, mask=mask_2d)"],"after_lines":["    tl.store(y_ptrs, x.T, mask=mask_2d)"]},{"before_lines":["    mask_2d = mask_m[:, None] & mask_n[None, :]"],"after_lines":["    mask_2d = mask_m[:, None] & mask_n[None, :]"]}] }
